title: Verified weighted Hilbert–Schmidt least-change updates and the DFP specialization
contribution_type: Two complete Lean formalizations of weighted least-change and DFP secant perturbation results

owner.source_commit_scope: Completed owning-project editorial record and its detailed lifecycle; the owning repository remains private.

claim: The displayed self-adjoint Hilbert–Schmidt secant perturbation uniquely minimizes the weighted Hilbert–Schmidt norm over all feasible perturbations on an arbitrary complete real inner-product space. Under the exact supplied invertible factor C and positive curvature, its weight is y and the DFP perturbation has the same feasibility, global minimality and uniqueness properties.

assumptions.space: Complete real inner-product space H; any Hilbert basis b with arbitrary index type. No finite-dimensional or separability restriction.
assumptions.base_operator: B : H →L[ℝ] H is self-adjoint. No positivity assumption is added.
assumptions.weight: R : H ≃L[ℝ] H is a continuous linear equivalence; c = adjoint(R.symm)(R.symm s).
assumptions.secant_data: y is arbitrary and s ≠ 0 for Proposition A.2.
assumptions.feasibility: P is Hilbert–Schmidt relative to b, self-adjoint, and (B+P)s=y.
assumptions.objective: hsNorm b (adjoint R ∘L P ∘L R); the proof establishes the required summability rather than relying on the nonsummable tsum default.
assumptions.dfp: 0 < ⟨y,s⟩ and a supplied continuous linear equivalence C with y=adjoint(C)(C s). R=C.symm; factor existence is outside this target.
